effect_sizes.name: phase-embedded KLD irreversibility vs shuffle null (nats/hour)
effect_sizes.method: re-embedded phase-randomised surrogate null (band shows the NULL, not the estimate)

n_justification: 840 hourly DAM LMPs (35 days, node TH_SP15_GEN-APND), 6 quantile bins -> 36 transition cells with ~23 observations per cell for k=1; the shuffle-surrogate null absorbs the plug-in bias at exactly this n, so detection is bias-robust by construction.
notes: First real-data instrument reading, with the methodological control in the same artifact: price-VALUE discretization is structurally blind to diurnal-loop irreversibility (the reversed loop retraces the same 1-D path), and reads at/below its surrogate null; the PHASE-SPACE embedding (price, Δ-sign) is where the loop stops retracing, and detection there means the day-ahead series is a measurably driven cycle, not an equilibrium fluctuation. TUR with held-out data-driven weights on the value chain is reported for completeness.
